:::{#exr-slr-additive}
#### Outcome as mean plus deviation

Show that each outcome in a simple linear regression model (@def-slr)
is its conditional mean plus its deviation (@def-slr-deviation):
$Y_i = \mean_i + \cdev_i$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-slr-additive}

$$
\begin{aligned}
Y_i
&= Y_i - \mean(x_i) + \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(add and subtract $\mean(x_i)$)}\\
&= \cdev_i + \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(definition of $\cdev_i$)}\\
&= \mean(x_i) + \cdev_i
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \mean_i + \cdev_i
&& \text{(definition of $\mean_i$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
